note: sRGB hex. Convert to linear for the renderer. Alpha where given is the fill alpha of the rect.
hueRule: The cool band 150-240 degrees is reserved for the local player at every player count. No team is red; 340-45 degrees is reserved for state signalling.

TEAM.OWN.use: your fleet and station, order marker and lines, build-progress fill, panel index bars

TEAM.B.use: hostile A - the MVP opponent, the furthest hue from own

SIG.ALERT.use: damage-alert stripe and triangle; the lost portion of every hull bar

SIG.SHORT.use: unaffordable cost, its index bar and bottom rule; cancel; the quit confirm

SIG.ARMED.use: armed module button, placement radius, credit-spend flash

SPACE.use: world clear colour - not drawn by the interface pass

PLATE.DIM.use: unavailable build button, under the 45deg hatch

PLATE.QUIT.use: the QUIT half of the quit confirm

RULE.use: hairlines, bar keylines, cell outlines, dim index bars

RULE.DIM.use: outline of an unavailable build button

RULE.LIT.use: outline and index bar of a live target

TICK.use: registration ticks at panel rule ends and the frame quarter points

TICK.BAR.use: quarter index ticks inside the hull and progress troughs

TRACK.use: hull trough, empty cargo chip, progress trough

TEXT.use: counts, costs, credits, live button names - about 10:1 on scrim over the band

TEXT.2.use: design names, labels, percent, link state

TEXT.DIM.use: unavailable button text - 4.9:1, readable and plainly recessed

HULL.LOST.use: hull lost, selection panel and world

HULL.REST.use: hull remaining, world bars only - deliberately near-invisible

typography.family: Segoe UI, pinned. A missing family is a startup failure, not a substitution (ADR-009).

BODY.use: design names, build item names, panel labels, link state, percent, overlay sublabels

DISPLAY.use: credit balance, build cost, selection group count, alert count, overlay headlines
